examples.en: She typed a short message and sent it to her friend.
examples.vi: Cô ấy đã gõ một tin nhắn ngắn và gửi cho bạn mình.

senses.definition: To arrange or classify things or people into distinct groups based on their features.

examples.en: Scientists type the new plant species according to leaf structure.
examples.vi: Các nhà khoa học phân loại loài thực vật mới theo cấu trúc lá.

thesaurus.definition: write by means of a keyboard with types
identify as belonging to a certain type

wiktionary.gloss: To put text on paper using a typewriter.
To enter text or commands into a computer using a keyboard.

examples: The doctor ordered the lab to type the patient for a blood transfusion.
wiktionary.gloss: To determine the blood type of.
To represent by a type, model, or symbol beforehand; to prefigure.
To furnish an expression or copy of; to represent; to typify.
To categorize into types.

blocks.etymology: From Middle English type (“symbol, figure, emblem”), from Latin typus, from Ancient Greek τύπος (túpos, “mark, impression, type”), from τύπτω (túptō, “to strike, beat”).

wiktionary.gloss: Very, extremely.

idioms.gloss: An expression of agreement or approval.
To behave in a manner that is completely different from what is expected based on one's role.
Of a plant or animal, typical of a certain breed or variety.

phrasal_verbs.gloss: To write out on a computer keyboard.
To type (a document) in its final, presentable form.

blocks.etymology: Learned borrowing from Old English werġeld, wereġeld (“compensation for a man killed”), from Proto-West Germanic *werageld. More at wer, geld.

wiktionary.gloss: Blood money, the monetary value assigned to a person, set according to their rank, used to determine the compensation paid by the perpetrator of a crime to the victim in the case of injury or to the victim's kindred in the case of homicide; such a reparative payment or compensation.
